env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# SPEC T-206 and 0.3: the group stage behaves the same natively, in the
# ejected module, and with upstream go1.27.2 for the result order, the
# window and the limit, the cancellation and early exit paths, and the
# sources and goroutines of the stages. Each fixture prints one ok line
# per case.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_order.lgo order/main.lgo
cd order
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_order.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_order.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_order.out
cd ../..

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_bound.lgo bound/main.lgo
cd bound
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_bound.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_bound.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_bound.out
cd ../..

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_cancel.lgo cancel/main.lgo
cd cancel
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_cancel.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_cancel.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_cancel.out
cd ../..

cp $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_sources.lgo sources/main.lgo
cd sources
logos run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_sources.out
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! exists out/main.lgo
cd out
go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_sources.out
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout $GOROOT/test/logos/run/chain_stage_sources.out
cd ../..

-- order/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstageorder

go 1.27

-- bound/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstagebound

go 1.27

-- cancel/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstagecancel

go 1.27

-- sources/go.mod --
module example.com/chainstagesources

go 1.27
